fusions.name: Tight Grouping
fusions.desc: Fires 3 rounds in a group tight enough that all 3 strike one target up to 9 tiles away, each dealing 2 damage.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Finish
fusions.desc: Fires a finishing shot at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health, and that threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Settled Sights
fusions.desc: After 1 second settling your aim, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighter
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a shot that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
